lines.note: 片首题辞的通行意译；为影片关于罪、命运与职业伦理的冷峻世界定调。

lines.text: 佛祖在地上画了一个红圈，说：当素不相识的人在此相逢，红圈便告完成。
lines.en: The Buddha drew a circle with a piece of red chalk and said: when men, even unknowingly, are to meet one day, they will inevitably come together to accomplish the great Circle of their destiny.
lines.note: 片头引语，为三人组合的命运作注；Wikiquote 可查。
